result.topic_en: Gauss combines two cyclic structures modulo p, generated by elements a and b of orders $\alpha$ and $\beta$, into a single element $c \equiv a^B b^C$ using the relation $\alpha A+\beta B+\gamma C=1$; he then tabulates powers $a^x b^y$ in a small example.
